description: Test file for the exec package in Kubernetes, testing command execution and probe functionality with fake command implementations.

classes.name: FakeCmd
classes.description: Fake command implementation for testing command execution.

classes.name: fakeExitError
classes.description: Fake error type simulating command exit errors.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Simulates running the command, always returns nil.

methods.name: CombinedOutput
methods.description: Returns the combined output and error.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Returns the standard output and error.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the command, writes output if writer is set.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for command completion, always returns nil.

methods.name: Exited
methods.description: Indicates if the command has exited.
